toolDescriptions.activate_block: Right-click a block: open a door, press a button, flip a lever, open a chest/furnace UI, use a crafting table, etc.
toolDescriptions.activate_entity: Right-click an entity with an EMPTY interaction (not using an item): open a villager's trade UI manually, sit a dog, take a leash point… For using a held ITEM on an entity (name_tag, saddle, shears, breeding food) use use_item with entity= instead.
toolDescriptions.anvil_use: Use a nearby anvil to combine two items (weapon + enchanted_book, or two damaged tools to merge enchants/repair) or rename one item.
toolDescriptions.build_blueprint: Build a multi-block structure from a plan in ONE call instead of dozens of place_block calls.
toolDescriptions.build_structure: Draft AND build a common shell parametrically — never hand-author dozens of blueprint offsets for a basic shape.
toolDescriptions.capture_view: SEE the world: capture a first-person screenshot from your own eyes and look at it.
toolDescriptions.check_darkness: Survey for hostile-spawnable darkness around you (or given coords): spots with standing room, a solid floor and block-light 0 — where mobs CAN appear at night or underground.
toolDescriptions.collect_ground_items: Walk over nearby dropped items on the ground to pick them up (within radius).
toolDescriptions.container_transact: Open a chest/barrel/shulker at coordinates and deposit or withdraw items in one transaction.
toolDescriptions.craft_item: Craft an item by name, CHAINING intermediate recipes automatically: asking for 'wooden_pickaxe' with only logs crafts planks → sticks → pickaxe in one call.
toolDescriptions.creative_fly: Creative-mode flight in a straight line to exact coordinates (hovers, ignores gravity).
toolDescriptions.creative_inventory: Creative-mode inventory magic: 'give' spawns any item into the first free hotbar slot, 'clear' empties the whole inventory.
toolDescriptions.dig_block: Dig (mine) the block at exact coordinates.
toolDescriptions.dig_vein: Mine an ENTIRE connected vein/trunk in one call — the companion to find_blocks clusters.
toolDescriptions.dismount: Get off the vehicle/mount you are currently riding.
toolDescriptions.eat: Eat food from inventory to restore hunger.
toolDescriptions.elytra_fly: Start gliding with an elytra: auto-equips it to the torso, jumps if on the ground, activates flight, optionally fires firework rockets for boost.
toolDescriptions.enchant_item: Enchant an item at a nearby enchanting table.
toolDescriptions.equip_item: Equip an inventory item: to 'hand' (tools/weapons/blocks), 'off-hand', or armor slots 'head'/'torso'/'legs'/'feet'.
toolDescriptions.find_blocks: Locate blocks by name near you.
toolDescriptions.find_player: Where is a player right now?
toolDescriptions.fish: Cast the fishing rod and wait for a catch (one full cast, typically 5–30 s — the caught item lands in inventory or right next to you).
toolDescriptions.follow_entity: Continuously follow a player or mob (non-blocking — keeps following until stop_moving is called).
toolDescriptions.forget_place: Delete a saved waypoint by name (see recall_places for names).
toolDescriptions.furnace_transact: Operate a furnace/blast_furnace/smoker at coordinates: check status (fuel %, smelt progress, what's in the 3 slots), load input ore/food, load fuel (coal, planks…), or take the finished output.
toolDescriptions.get_status: Your vital signs and situation: position, health, food, oxygen, XP, held item, time of day, weather, dimension, game mode.
toolDescriptions.go_to: Walk somewhere using pathfinding (digs through obstacles if needed): x,y,z coordinates, OR an entity/player by name.
toolDescriptions.inspect_block: Examine the block at exact coordinates: what it is, whether you can dig it, how long digging takes.
toolDescriptions.journey_status: Check your journeys — current one and past ones, with their step-by-step journal.
toolDescriptions.list_inventory: Everything you are carrying: item names, counts, and which slot.
toolDescriptions.look_around: Survey the surroundings: nearby entities (players, mobs, animals, items on ground) within radius, sorted by distance, plus the block you are standing on and what is at your cursor.
toolDescriptions.look_at: Point your head at exact coordinates, or at an entity by name.
toolDescriptions.manage_bots: Hire and manage worker bots — real second bodies that join the server and work a task autonomously in parallel with you (their own legs, no interference with yours).
toolDescriptions.mount_entity: Climb into/onto a rideable entity: boat, minecart, horse (must be tamed), camel, strider… Walks to it first.
toolDescriptions.move: Raw movement control for a duration: walk 'forward'/'back'/'left'/'right', 'jump', 'sprint', or 'sneak'.
toolDescriptions.place_block: Place a block from your inventory at coordinates.
toolDescriptions.place_entity: Place an entity item from inventory into the world: a boat on water, a minecart on rails, an armor stand, a spawn egg… Give the item name and the block position to place ON TOP of (e.g.
toolDescriptions.read_hud: Read server-driven HUD state: scoreboards (sidebar objectives + scores), boss bars (e.g.
toolDescriptions.recall_places: List saved waypoints from persistent memory (name, position, distance from you, note, when saved).
toolDescriptions.remember_place: Save a named waypoint to persistent memory — it survives restarts and is shared with worker bots.
toolDescriptions.respawn: Come back after dying (check get_status: dead=true, or actions failing with weird errors).
toolDescriptions.say_in_chat: Say something in the public game chat.
toolDescriptions.sleep_in_bed: Find the nearest bed, walk to it, and sleep.
toolDescriptions.start_journey: Begin a long-term background goal that outlives this conversation turn — you will automatically take a step toward it every few seconds until it is done ("collect 64 iron", "build a cobblestone tower", "explore north until you find a village").
toolDescriptions.steer_vehicle: Drive the vehicle you are riding (boat, pig with carrot-on-stick, strider) for a duration.
toolDescriptions.stop_journey: Stop the running journey after its current step lands.
toolDescriptions.stop_moving: Stop all movement immediately: cancels pathfinding, following, and any held control states.
toolDescriptions.teleport: Instantly teleport (server /tp — needs cheats enabled, as in an Open-to-LAN world with cheats).
toolDescriptions.toss_item: Throw items from inventory onto the ground (e.g.
toolDescriptions.trade_with_villager: Trade with a villager or wandering trader.
toolDescriptions.turn: Turn your view by a relative amount: 'left'/'right' rotate yaw by degrees, 'up'/'down' tilt pitch.
toolDescriptions.unequip: Remove equipment from a slot (take off armor, empty the hand/off-hand) back into inventory.
toolDescriptions.use_item: Right-click ('use') an item — one verb, any target.
toolDescriptions.voice_config: Inspect or change the voice used on realtime calls.
toolDescriptions.voice_say: Speak to the player OUT LOUD over the live voice channel.
toolDescriptions.whisper: Send a private message to one player.
toolDescriptions.write_book: Write pages into a writable_book (book and quill) in inventory.
toolDescriptions.write_sign: Write text on a sign that's already placed (place_block a sign first).
